items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: with Frankie Newton for about a week

ctx.x: Then I went down to the Village and I worked some club where the girl -- the girly shows were, with Frankie Newton for about a week and then I stumbled upon Eddie Heywood's trio by being down there, you know. You get lost quickly in the Village quicker than any place I've ever been. You turn the corner and you'd be lost. At least I found it that way. I had to be led around. Shown. I could find my way to work but after that, I'd be afraid to move (laughter).
You worked with Eddie Heywood quite a while?
